archetype: agent with file-tool access recursively deletes a working tree and overwrites a surviving file

ground_truth.definition: tightest CoW/Merkle checkpoint at or before the malicious recursive-delete + overwrite
ground_truth.computed_from: archive snapshots.json recorded_lsn <= injection lsn_start, then lab-coordinate

evidence_signature.db: no required DB burst; filesystem damage is the signal
evidence_signature.filesystem: burst of delete/overwrite ops across many paths from one process
evidence_signature.derived: path-churn/deletion spike vs the overlapping build-and-edit confounder
evidence_signature.graph: one process touching a whole subtree
